Un GPS français gratuit calcule ce que votre trajet va vous coûter, pas seulement le temps

📅 2026-07-27 ✍️ Capital.fr 🏷️ Roole Map, GPS, France, trip cost calculation, EV charging, CarPlay, Android Auto, free navigation, Waze alternative
🔗 Read the source article →

💡 Quick summary

French GPS app Roole Map differentiates itself from Waze and Google Maps by calculating the total cost of a trip—including fuel or electricity consumption and tolls—making it the first free, ad-free navigation app certified as French-origin.

📌 Key takeaways

  • Roole Map, launched in 2022 as a rebrand of Club Identicar, has surpassed American competitors in French app store download rankings in early 2026
  • The app's key differentiator is trip cost calculation: it estimates total journey cost including fuel/electricity consumption and tolls, a feature absent from Waze and Google Maps
  • For combustion vehicles, the app displays service stations with fuel prices by brand and available services; for EVs, it shows compatible charging stations with connector types, power, availability, and pricing
  • The app is compatible with CarPlay and Android Auto, supports community reporting of accidents, construction, and road hazards (added in spring 2026)
  • Limitations include coverage limited to French roads only, internet requirement for real-time traffic, and a smaller user community making it less reactive than Waze on minor roads
